integrity: All proof steps are symbolic or follow from uniform convergence and the published finite contact theorem. The standalone verifier uses exact outward-rounded integer interval arithmetic; no finite enumeration is used to justify the asymptotic quantifier.
scientific_limitations: The finite realization principle applies only to strictly feasible continuous endpoint solutions with a simple scalar root and nonvanishing recovery denominator. The numerical corollary certifies an existential finite lower bound 1.0633 but gives no explicit m_0, coordinates or global optimum. It does not establish the source paper's proposed boundary value 1.0633083238.
title: Transversal continuous triangle chains admit finite non-separable realizations
